headword: {軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}

definitions.explanation: Acting without careful thought; behaving recklessly or impulsively without considering consequences.

examples.japanese: {軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}を{慎|つつし}むべきだ。
examples.english: One should refrain from rash actions.

examples.japanese: {軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}は{禁物|きんもつ}だ。
{今|いま}は{軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}せず、{様子|ようす}を{見|み}よう。
examples.english: Let's not act rashly now and observe the situation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}が{事態|じたい}を{悪化|あっか}させた。
examples.english: His rash actions worsened the situation.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご})

COMPONENTS:
・{軽|けい} - light, careless
・{挙|きょ} - action, movement
・{妄|もう} - reckless, wild
・{動|どう} - movement, action

USAGE: Often used as a warning or criticism. Commonly appears with {慎|つつし}む (to refrain from) or {禁物|きんもつ} (forbidden thing).

GRAMMAR:
・{軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}する (to act recklessly - suru verb)
・{軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}を{慎|つつし}む (to refrain from rash action)
・{軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}は{禁物|きんもつ}だ (rash action is forbidden)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{衝動的|しょうどうてき} - impulsive
・{短慮|たんりょ} - hasty, thoughtless
・{無謀|むぼう} - reckless, foolhardy
